feed.title: Built for the *fleet.* Then we *play.*
feed.lede: We build tools we actually use and ship them on the runtime we wrote for it. Here is what is running right now: every picture below is the real thing, captured live.

lab.title: Combine words. *Get software.*
lab.lede: Every game and app we ship is a verb and a noun. Drop one on the other and it appears; click it to go. The whole shelf is in the bag if you would rather just pick.

products.title: What we *build.*
products.lede: A code host for agents, the runtime it ships on, and everything we've built with them.

services.title: We *wire it up.*
services.lede: The work we take on for a business, built on the same stack as everything on this page.

webapps.title: Web apps & web solutions
webapps.text: Full-stack apps on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, real-time when they need to be.

architecture.title: Solutions architecture
architecture.text: Pick the pieces, draw the lines, and ship something that stays up and stays cheap.

warehouse.title: Custom warehouse integrations
warehouse.text: Your warehouse system talking to your store, your CRM and your carriers, without a spreadsheet in the middle.

threepl.title: 3PL app integrations
threepl.text: Orders out to your third-party logistics partner, tracking and inventory back, on every channel you sell through.

dropship.title: Drop shipping integrations
dropship.text: Each order line routed to the supplier that ships it, with stock and tracking kept in step with your storefront.

desktop.title: Desktop apps from web apps
desktop.text: Your web app as one double-clickable file with *Rusty Buns*, its server moving with it.

games.title: The *tables.*
games.lede: The games shipped on Rusty Buns, and a draft of the cube where QNTBR started.

apps.title: The *rest.*
apps.lede: A proof-of-concept CRM, packing and fulfillment tools, Qlave calls, Flareup and Staticflare, one login for everything, and a workshop of smaller apps.

about.label: About
about.text: QNTBR is a *solutions architecture studio* focused on web apps and web solutions. We build tools we actually use, and ship them on the runtime we wrote for it. The goal is software that works, ships fast, and stays out of your way.
